decisions.reason: The firm raised its commitment by giving the single-tube condenser a page of its own in 2024, and it is central to the firm's air-cooled heat exchanger line, so management will persist with it.
Like B, this condenser now has a dedicated page, a visible public commitment that management will want to justify rather than reverse.
The tube liner fits the firm's service and repair business and needs little further investment, so weak results would likely be blamed on temporary market causes rather than lead to withdrawal.
Customized industrial air coolers are close to the firm's core engineering competence and are built to order, so there is little reason to drop them.
Tube end repair inserts complement the liner offering for maintenance customers and cost little to keep, so management continues despite their modest visibility.
